title: Rejewski Finding Triage Record
description: Hand-authored triage record for a Rejewski finding: the ATT&CK technique observed, the run that produced it, its severity and confidence ratings, the replay-log evidence backing it, and its triage disposition. Optionally cross-references a finding-to-control mapping by slug. additionalProperties: false on every object; explicit required arrays; draft 2020-12.

finding_id.description: Stable kebab-case slug uniquely identifying this triage record.

technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID, e.g. T1087.004.

run_id.description: Consent-flow run ID that produced this finding, e.g. R010.

confidence.description: Confidence that this finding is real and correctly attributed.

control_id.description: Optional cross-reference to a finding-to-control mapping record, by that record's mapping_id slug (e.g. ft1087-004-ca-cov008-blockbylocation-001). Omit when the finding is not yet mapped to a control.

evidence.description: Paths to committed replay-log samples that demonstrate this finding. May be empty for a finding recorded before its evidence is committed.

notes.description: Optional free-text triage notes. Omit when empty.

created_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this triage record was authored.

author.description: Author or system that created this triage record.

schema_version.description: Schema version; always '0.1' for this schema.
